concepts.label: Meter
concepts.note: Organization of beats into bars with recurring accents.

concepts.label: Simple meter
concepts.note: Each beat divides into two.

concepts.label: 2/4 time
concepts.note: Two beats per bar; marches, polka, cumbia.

concepts.label: 3/4 time
concepts.note: Three beats per bar; waltz, mazurka, many folk ballads.

concepts.label: 4/4 time
concepts.note: The default meter of nearly all popular music.

concepts.label: Compound meter
concepts.note: Each beat divides into three.

concepts.label: 6/8 time
concepts.note: Two triple-divided beats; jig, Irish ballads, slow doo-wop.

concepts.label: 9/8 time
concepts.note: Three triple-divided beats, or aksak groupings (2+2+2+3).

concepts.label: 12/8 time
concepts.note: Four triple-divided beats; slow blues, soul, rock and roll ballads.

concepts.label: Odd meter
concepts.note: Bars whose beats don't group evenly.

concepts.label: 5/4 time
concepts.note: Five beats (3+2 or 2+3).

concepts.label: 5/8 time
concepts.note: Five eighth notes, grouped 2+3 or 3+2.

concepts.label: 7/8 time
concepts.note: Seven eighth notes (2+2+3, 3+2+2…); prog rock, Balkan music.

concepts.label: 7/4 time
concepts.note: Seven quarter notes per bar.

concepts.label: 11/8 time
concepts.note: Eleven eighth notes; Balkan folk, progressive metal.

concepts.label: 13/8 time
concepts.note: Thirteen eighth notes; prog rock and math rock.

concepts.label: Aksak rhythm
concepts.note: Uneven groupings of 2s and 3s typical of Turkey and the Balkans.

concepts.label: Mixed meter
concepts.note: Frequent alternation of different time signatures within a section.

concepts.label: Free meter
concepts.note: Passages without a regular pulse, shaped by the phrase.

concepts.label: Hemiola
concepts.note: Three duple beats laid over or alternating with two triple ones (metric 3:2).

concepts.label: Polymeter
concepts.note: Simultaneous layers in different meters sharing a pulse.

concepts.label: Rhythmic feel
concepts.note: How the pulse is subdivided and placed, beyond the time signature.

concepts.label: Straight feel
concepts.note: Even subdivisions, no swing.

concepts.label: Swing
concepts.note: Uneven (long-short) eighth notes built on a triplet.

concepts.label: Shuffle
concepts.note: A steady, pronounced swing pattern; the basis of blues and boogie.

concepts.label: Triplet feel
concepts.note: A pulse consistently subdivided into three.

concepts.label: Half-time feel
concepts.note: The snare lands every other beat, so the music feels half as fast.

concepts.label: Double-time feel
concepts.note: Percussion doubles the apparent speed of the pulse.

concepts.label: Laid-back feel
concepts.note: Playing slightly behind the beat for a relaxed feel.

concepts.label: Driving feel
concepts.note: Playing ahead of or insistently on the beat for urgency.

concepts.label: Rhythmic devices
concepts.note: Techniques that alter or enrich the basic pattern.

concepts.label: Syncopation
concepts.note: Accents on weak beats or between beats.

concepts.label: Anticipation
concepts.note: A note or chord that arrives before the strong beat it was expected on.

concepts.label: Offbeat
concepts.note: Systematic accenting of the weak parts of the beat.

concepts.label: Backbeat
concepts.note: Snare accent on beats 2 and 4 of a 4/4 bar.

concepts.label: Polyrhythm
concepts.note: Two or more conflicting subdivisions at once (3:2, 4:3…).

concepts.label: Three against two
concepts.note: Three even notes against two in the same span.

concepts.label: Four against three
concepts.note: Four notes against three in the same span.

concepts.label: Cross-rhythm
concepts.note: Sustained polyrhythm as a structural basis, typical of West African music.

concepts.label: Clave
concepts.note: Five-stroke guide pattern in Afro-Cuban music.

concepts.label: Son clave
concepts.note: Son clave in its 3-2 and 2-3 orientations.

concepts.label: Rumba clave
concepts.note: Variant with the third stroke delayed.

concepts.label: Bossa nova clave
concepts.note: Brazilian clave variant used in bossa nova.

concepts.label: Tresillo
concepts.note: 3+3+2 grouping of eighth notes, core of Afro-Latin rhythm and today's pop.

concepts.label: Habanera rhythm
concepts.note: Tresillo with an added note on beat two.

concepts.label: Stop-time
concepts.note: The band plays only isolated hits, leaving gaps for vocals or a solo.

concepts.label: Rhythmic displacement
concepts.note: A motif repeated shifted against the beat.

concepts.label: Metric modulation
concepts.note: Tempo change derived from a shared subdivision.

concepts.label: Anacrusis
concepts.note: Notes before the first downbeat of a phrase.

concepts.label: Ensemble hits
concepts.note: Accents played by the whole band together.

concepts.label: Tempo
concepts.note: Speed of the pulse, in beats per minute.

concepts.label: Very slow tempo
concepts.note: Below ~60 BPM.

concepts.label: Very fast tempo
concepts.note: Above ~160 BPM.

concepts.label: Tempo change
concepts.note: Tempo variation within the piece.

concepts.label: Accelerando
concepts.note: Gradual speeding up.

concepts.label: Ritardando
concepts.note: Gradual slowing down, typical of endings.

concepts.label: Rubato
concepts.note: Expressive flexibility of tempo.

concepts.label: Fermata
concepts.note: A note or rest held beyond its value.

concepts.label: Tempo switch
concepts.note: Sudden jump to another tempo between sections.

concepts.label: Drum patterns
concepts.note: Drum patterns that identify styles.

concepts.label: Basic rock beat
concepts.note: Kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4, eighth-note hi-hats.

concepts.label: Four-on-the-floor
concepts.note: Kick on every beat of a 4/4 bar; disco and house.

concepts.label: Stomp and clap beat
concepts.note: Heavily accented alternating kick and handclap; glam and modern folk-pop.

concepts.label: Breakbeat
concepts.note: Syncopated pattern taken from funk breaks, often sampled.

concepts.label: Amen break
concepts.note: The break from "Amen, Brother" (The Winstons), foundation of jungle and drum and bass.

concepts.label: Chopped breaks
concepts.note: Sampled breaks rearranged at high speed.

concepts.label: 2-step beat
concepts.note: Syncopated pattern without a kick on every beat; UK garage.

concepts.label: Boom bap
concepts.note: Dry, prominent sampled kick and snare; 90s hip hop.

concepts.label: Trap beat
concepts.note: Sixteenth-note hi-hats with rolls, long 808, half-time snare.

concepts.label: Trap hi-hats
concepts.note: Hi-hats with 32nd-note and triplet rolls.

concepts.label: Drill beat
concepts.note: Displaced snare, triplet hi-hats and gliding 808.

concepts.label: Dembow
concepts.note: Quarter-note kick with a tresillo snare (3+3+2); reggaeton.

concepts.label: One drop
concepts.note: Kick and snare together only on beat three; roots reggae.

concepts.label: Steppers
concepts.note: Quarter-note kick in reggae and dub.

concepts.label: Rockers beat
concepts.note: Late-70s reggae pattern with busier kick and hi-hat.

concepts.label: D-beat
concepts.note: Hardcore punk pattern derived from Discharge.

concepts.label: Skank beat
concepts.note: Kick and snare alternating at high speed.

concepts.label: Blast beat
concepts.note: Kick, snare and cymbals at maximum speed; grindcore and death/black metal.

concepts.label: Double bass drumming
concepts.note: Kick played with two beaters in continuous sixteenths or bursts.

concepts.label: Gallop rhythm
concepts.note: Eighth–two-sixteenths figure repeated on guitar or kick; classic heavy metal.

concepts.label: Motorik
concepts.note: Hypnotic, steady 4/4 pulse; krautrock.

concepts.label: Train beat
concepts.note: Continuous snare pattern imitating a train; country and rockabilly.

concepts.label: Purdie shuffle
concepts.note: Half-time shuffle with ghost notes.

concepts.label: Second line
concepts.note: New Orleans parade groove.

concepts.label: Bossa nova beat
concepts.note: Cross-stick on the bossa clave with kick on 2.

concepts.label: Samba batucada
concepts.note: Samba percussion with surdo, caixa and tamborim.

concepts.label: Baião rhythm
concepts.note: Northeastern Brazilian rhythm with zabumba and triangle.

concepts.label: Cumbia rhythm
concepts.note: Guacharaca or güira in eighths with kick in 2/4.

concepts.label: Tumbao
concepts.note: Syncopated conga or bass pattern in salsa and son.

concepts.label: Afrobeat drumming
concepts.note: Polyrhythmic drum pattern in the style of Tony Allen.

concepts.label: Jersey club beat
concepts.note: Kick pattern in five-stroke bursts with bed-squeak samples.

concepts.label: Footwork beat
concepts.note: Syncopated kick patterns at ~160 BPM.

concepts.label: Dancehall riddim
concepts.note: Repeated rhythm track that different artists sing over.

concepts.label: Tamborzão
concepts.note: Funk carioca percussion pattern derived from Miami bass.

concepts.label: Log drum groove
concepts.note: Amapiano's percussive bass pattern.

concepts.label: Drum techniques
concepts.note: Drumming performance techniques.

concepts.label: Ghost notes
concepts.note: Very soft snare strokes between the main ones.

concepts.label: Drum fill
concepts.note: Short drum phrase linking sections.

concepts.label: Drum roll
concepts.note: Rapid, continuous succession of strokes.

concepts.label: Snare build-up
concepts.note: Accelerating snare roll before a drop.

concepts.label: Flam
concepts.note: Two near-simultaneous strokes, one a grace note.

concepts.label: Cross-stick
concepts.note: Stroke with the stick resting across the rim.

concepts.label: Tribal toms
concepts.note: Insistent patterns on the low toms.

concepts.label: Drum solo
concepts.note: Showcase section for the drums.

concepts.label: Linear drumming
concepts.note: No two strokes coincide; fluid funk and fusion patterns.

concepts.label: Brushes
concepts.note: Playing with brushes; jazz and ballads.

concepts.label: Tonality
concepts.note: Organization of pitches around a tonic.

concepts.label: Major key
concepts.note: Major tonal center, generally bright in character.

concepts.label: Minor key
concepts.note: Minor tonal center, generally dark in character.

concepts.label: Modality
concepts.note: Harmony based on a mode rather than major/minor functions.

concepts.label: Atonality
concepts.note: Absence of a tonal center.

concepts.label: Polytonality
concepts.note: Two or more keys at once.

concepts.label: Microtonality
concepts.note: Intervals smaller than a semitone.

concepts.label: Chords
concepts.note: Chord types by construction.

concepts.label: Triad
concepts.note: Three-note chord stacked in thirds.

concepts.label: Power chord
concepts.note: Root and fifth with no third; the basis of rock and metal.

concepts.label: Seventh chord
concepts.note: Triad with an added seventh.

concepts.label: Major seventh chord
concepts.note: Soft-colored chord typical of jazz, soul and city pop.

concepts.label: Minor seventh chord
concepts.note: Minor chord with a seventh; staple of R&B and neo soul.

concepts.label: Dominant seventh chord
concepts.note: Tense chord that wants to resolve; everywhere in blues.

concepts.label: Half-diminished chord
concepts.note: Diminished triad with a minor seventh.

concepts.label: Extended chords
concepts.note: Chords with 9ths, 11ths or 13ths.

concepts.label: Suspended chord
concepts.note: The third replaced by the second or fourth.

concepts.label: Added-tone chord
concepts.note: Triad with an added note but no seventh.

concepts.label: Diminished chord
concepts.note: Stacked minor thirds.

concepts.label: Augmented chord
concepts.note: Stacked major thirds.

concepts.label: Altered chord
concepts.note: Dominant with altered ninth or fifth.

concepts.label: Slash chord
concepts.note: Chord with a note other than the root in the bass.

concepts.label: Quartal harmony
concepts.note: Chords built in fourths; modal jazz.

concepts.label: Tone cluster
concepts.note: Adjacent notes played together.

concepts.label: Neapolitan chord
concepts.note: Major chord on the lowered second degree.

concepts.label: Harmonic devices
concepts.note: Techniques of harmonic color and motion.

concepts.label: Modal mixture
concepts.note: Chords borrowed from the parallel mode.

concepts.label: Secondary dominant
concepts.note: Dominant of a degree other than the tonic.

concepts.label: Tritone substitution
concepts.note: Replacing a dominant with the one a tritone away.

concepts.label: Chromatic mediant
concepts.note: Chords a third apart with a chromatic change; typical of film scores.

concepts.label: Picardy third
concepts.note: Minor-key piece ending on a major chord.

concepts.label: Tritone
concepts.note: Three-whole-tone interval; unsettling sound much used in metal.

concepts.label: Dissonance
concepts.note: Systematic use of tense, unresolved intervals.

concepts.label: Pedal point
concepts.note: Sustained or repeated note under changing chords.

concepts.label: Reharmonization
concepts.note: Changing the chords under a known melody.

concepts.label: Harmonic rhythm
concepts.note: Rate at which chords change.

concepts.label: Jazz harmony
concepts.note: Systematic use of seventh chords, extensions and substitutions.

concepts.label: Passing chord
concepts.note: Brief chord connecting two structural chords.

concepts.label: Descending chromatic bass
concepts.note: Bass descending by semitones under changing chords.

concepts.label: Line cliché
concepts.note: An inner voice moves chromatically over a fixed chord.

concepts.label: Chord progressions
concepts.note: Stock chord successions.

concepts.label: I–V–vi–IV progression
concepts.note: The most-used pop progression since the 2000s.

concepts.label: I–vi–IV–V progression
concepts.note: Progression of doo-wop and 50s pop.

concepts.label: ii–V–I
concepts.note: Basic cadential cell of jazz.

concepts.label: Twelve-bar blues
concepts.note: I-IV-V scheme over twelve bars.

concepts.label: Andalusian cadence
concepts.note: Four-chord descent of flamenco and Spanish music.

concepts.label: Circle-of-fifths progression
concepts.note: Roots descending by fifths.

concepts.label: Pachelbel progression
concepts.note: Eight-chord progression of the Canon in D.

concepts.label: Royal road progression
concepts.note: Signature progression of J-pop and anime.

concepts.label: i–VI–III–VII progression
concepts.note: Minor progression of epic rock, EDM and trailers.

concepts.label: I–♭VII–IV progression
concepts.note: Classic rock progression based on the Mixolydian mode.

concepts.label: Vamp
concepts.note: Two chords alternating at length.

concepts.label: One-chord harmony
concepts.note: Piece or section on a single chord.

concepts.label: Minor plagal cadence
concepts.note: Minor subdominant resolving to a major tonic; very emotional.

concepts.label: Cadences
concepts.note: Harmonic formulas that close a phrase.

concepts.label: Authentic cadence
concepts.note: Dominant to tonic; conclusive close.

concepts.label: Plagal cadence
concepts.note: Subdominant to tonic.

concepts.label: Half cadence
concepts.note: Phrase ending on the dominant, left hanging.

concepts.label: Deceptive cadence
concepts.note: The dominant resolves to an unexpected chord.

concepts.label: Backdoor cadence
concepts.note: Arriving at the tonic from the flat seventh.

concepts.label: Modulation
concepts.note: Change of tonal center within the piece.

concepts.label: Truck driver's modulation
concepts.note: Key change up a half or whole step in the last chorus.

concepts.label: Pivot-chord modulation
concepts.note: Key change via a chord common to both keys.

concepts.label: Direct modulation
concepts.note: Key change without preparation.

concepts.label: Parallel key shift
concepts.note: Switching between major and minor on the same tonic.

concepts.label: Scales
concepts.note: Ordered pitch sets used as melodic material.

concepts.label: Major scale
concepts.note: Diatonic major scale.

concepts.label: Natural minor scale
concepts.note: Diatonic minor scale.

concepts.label: Harmonic minor scale
concepts.note: Minor with a raised seventh; "neoclassical" sound.

concepts.label: Melodic minor scale
concepts.note: Minor with raised sixth and seventh.

concepts.label: Pentatonic scale
concepts.note: Five-note scales.

concepts.label: Major pentatonic
concepts.note: Bright pentatonic; country, folk, East Asian music.

concepts.label: Minor pentatonic
concepts.note: The basis of blues and rock solos.

concepts.label: Blues scale
concepts.note: Minor pentatonic with an augmented fourth (the blue note).

concepts.label: Whole-tone scale
concepts.note: Six notes a whole step apart; dreamlike effect.

concepts.label: Diminished scale
concepts.note: Alternating whole and half steps; tension in jazz, metal and film scores.

concepts.label: Chromatic scale
concepts.note: All twelve pitches by semitones.

concepts.label: Bebop scale
concepts.note: Eight-note scale with a chromatic passing tone.

concepts.label: Altered scale
concepts.note: Scale for altered dominants in jazz.

concepts.label: Modes
concepts.note: Rotations of the diatonic scale, each with its own color.

concepts.label: Dorian mode
concepts.note: Minor with a major sixth; funk, modal jazz, Celtic folk.

concepts.label: Phrygian mode
concepts.note: Minor with a minor second; flamenco and metal.

concepts.label: Lydian mode
concepts.note: Major with an augmented fourth; magical or floating sound, common in film scores.

concepts.label: Mixolydian mode
concepts.note: Major with a minor seventh; classic rock and folk.

concepts.label: Locrian mode
concepts.note: Mode with a diminished fifth; very unstable sound.

concepts.label: Non-Western and exotic scales
concepts.note: Scales tied to specific traditions.

concepts.label: Phrygian dominant scale
concepts.note: Phrygian with a major third; flamenco, klezmer and Middle Eastern music.

concepts.label: Double harmonic scale
concepts.note: Scale with two augmented seconds.

concepts.label: Hungarian minor scale
concepts.note: Harmonic minor with an augmented fourth.

concepts.label: Japanese scales
concepts.note: Japanese pentatonics with semitones.

concepts.label: Maqam
concepts.note: Arabic and Turkish modal system with microtones.

concepts.label: Raga
concepts.note: Melodic framework of Indian classical music.

concepts.label: Pelog and slendro
concepts.note: Tuning systems of Indonesian gamelan.

concepts.label: Melodic elements
concepts.note: Recognizable melodic units.

concepts.label: Hook
concepts.note: Short, catchy phrase designed to stick.

concepts.label: Riff
concepts.note: Short repeated instrumental figure that carries the song.

concepts.label: Motif
concepts.note: Smallest melodic or rhythmic idea that gets developed.

concepts.label: Leitmotif
concepts.note: Motif tied to a character or idea that recurs.

concepts.label: Ostinato
concepts.note: Persistently repeated figure.

concepts.label: Countermelody
concepts.note: Secondary line in dialogue with the main melody.

concepts.label: Topline
concepts.note: Main sung melody over the track.

concepts.label: Arpeggio
concepts.note: Chord notes played one after another.

concepts.label: Melodic sequence
concepts.note: A motif repeated at other pitches.

concepts.label: Melodic devices
concepts.note: Techniques of ornament and color in the line.

concepts.label: Chromaticism
concepts.note: Use of out-of-scale notes by semitones.

concepts.label: Blue note
concepts.note: Flattened, ambiguous third, fifth or seventh.

concepts.label: Ornamentation
concepts.note: Decorative notes on the melody.

concepts.label: Trill
concepts.note: Rapid alternation between two neighboring notes.

concepts.label: Mordent
concepts.note: Quick ornament with a neighboring note.

concepts.label: Grace note
concepts.note: Brief ornamental note before the main one.

concepts.label: Turn
concepts.note: Ornament that circles the main note.

concepts.label: Glissando
concepts.note: Continuous slide from one pitch to another.

concepts.label: Melisma
concepts.note: Several notes on a single syllable.

concepts.label: Syllabic setting
concepts.note: One note per syllable.

concepts.label: Conjunct motion
concepts.note: Melody moving by step.

concepts.label: Disjunct motion
concepts.note: Melody with wide leaps.

concepts.label: Octave doubling
concepts.note: Line doubled at the octave.

concepts.label: Improvisation
concepts.note: Melodic creation in real time.

concepts.label: Modal improvisation
concepts.note: Improvising over a mode with few chord changes.

concepts.label: Trading fours
concepts.note: Soloists alternating every few bars.

concepts.label: Song sections
concepts.note: Building blocks of a popular song. Many work as structure tags in prompts.

concepts.label: Intro
concepts.note: Opening section before the first verse.

concepts.label: Verse
concepts.note: Narrative section with changing lyrics.

concepts.label: Pre-chorus
concepts.note: Section that builds tension before the chorus.

concepts.label: Chorus
concepts.note: Central section repeated with the same lyrics.

concepts.label: Post-chorus
concepts.note: Extra hook after the chorus.

concepts.label: Refrain
concepts.note: Line repeated at the end of each verse.

concepts.label: Bridge
concepts.note: Contrasting section, usually once, before the last chorus.

concepts.label: Interlude
concepts.note: Instrumental or transitional section between parts.

concepts.label: Instrumental break
concepts.note: Passage without vocals.

concepts.label: Solo section
concepts.note: Showcase section for an instrument.

concepts.label: Guitar solo
concepts.note: Electric or acoustic guitar solo.

concepts.label: Breakdown (metal)
concepts.note: Slow, heavy section of syncopated muted chords.

concepts.label: Breakdown (EDM)
concepts.note: Low-energy section without kick before the build.

concepts.label: Build-up
concepts.note: Progressive rise in tension before the drop.

concepts.label: Drop
concepts.note: Climax of an electronic track, where bass and kick come in.

concepts.label: Beat switch
concepts.note: Complete change of beat mid-track; hip hop.

concepts.label: Hook (hip hop)
concepts.note: The chorus of a rap track.

concepts.label: Skit
concepts.note: Spoken piece or short scene on a hip hop record.

concepts.label: Spoken intro
concepts.note: Recited opening before the music.

concepts.label: Final chorus
concepts.note: Last chorus, often intensified or doubled.

concepts.label: Turnaround
concepts.note: Chord passage leading back to the top of the form.

concepts.label: Tag ending
concepts.note: Final repetition of the last line.

concepts.label: Outro
concepts.note: Closing section.

concepts.label: Fade-out
concepts.note: The song ends by gradually lowering the volume.

concepts.label: Cold ending
concepts.note: Ending on a hit, no fade.

concepts.label: False ending
concepts.note: Pause that fakes the ending before the music returns.

concepts.label: A cappella section
concepts.note: Voices-only passage.

concepts.label: Dramatic pause
concepts.note: Brief total silence for impact.

concepts.label: Song forms
concepts.note: Overall organizational schemes.

concepts.label: Verse–chorus form
concepts.note: Alternating verses and choruses with an optional bridge.

concepts.label: AABA form
concepts.note: Form of the Tin Pan Alley standards.

concepts.label: Strophic form
concepts.note: Same music for every verse.

concepts.label: Through-composed form
concepts.note: No repeated sections.

concepts.label: Binary form
concepts.note: Two contrasting sections.

concepts.label: Ternary form
concepts.note: Statement, contrast and return.

concepts.label: EDM arrangement
concepts.note: Intro–build–drop–breakdown–build–drop–outro.

concepts.label: Multi-part epic
concepts.note: Long composition with linked movements; progressive rock.

concepts.label: Loop-based form
concepts.note: Structure built by adding and removing layers over a loop.

concepts.label: Medley
concepts.note: Chain of fragments from several songs.

concepts.label: Reprise
concepts.note: Return of an earlier theme at the end of a record or work.

concepts.label: Segue
concepts.note: Seamless transition from one piece to the next.

concepts.label: Compositional forms
concepts.note: Forms of the art-music tradition, aligned with LCGFT.

concepts.label: Fugue
concepts.note: Contrapuntal form based on imitation of a subject.

concepts.label: Canon
concepts.note: Strict imitation of one voice by another after a delay.

concepts.label: Round
concepts.note: Canon at the unison that repeats indefinitely.

concepts.label: Invention
concepts.note: Short contrapuntal piece in two or three voices.

concepts.label: Sonata form
concepts.note: Exposition, development and recapitulation of two themes.

concepts.label: Theme and variations
concepts.note: A theme followed by successive transformations.

concepts.label: Passacaglia
concepts.note: Variations over a repeated bass or progression.

concepts.label: Rondo
concepts.note: Instrumental refrain alternating with episodes.

concepts.label: Toccata
concepts.note: Virtuosic keyboard piece with fast figuration.

concepts.label: Prelude
concepts.note: Introductory or short free-form piece.

concepts.label: Étude
concepts.note: Piece focused on a technical difficulty.

concepts.label: Nocturne
concepts.note: Lyrical, night-themed piano piece.

concepts.label: March
concepts.note: Piece in 2/4 or 4/4 at a military pace.

concepts.label: Waltz
concepts.note: Dance in 3/4 accented on beat one.

concepts.label: Minuet
concepts.note: Courtly dance in 3/4.

concepts.label: Scherzo
concepts.note: Fast, playful movement in 3/4.

concepts.label: Aria
concepts.note: Lyrical solo vocal piece within a larger work.

concepts.label: Recitative
concepts.note: Declaimed singing that follows speech rhythm.

concepts.label: Chorale
concepts.note: Lutheran hymn harmonized in four parts.

concepts.label: Motet
concepts.note: Sacred polyphonic choral composition.

concepts.label: Madrigal
concepts.note: Secular polyphonic vocal composition of the Renaissance.

concepts.label: Mass
concepts.note: Music for the Ordinary of the Mass.

concepts.label: Hymn
concepts.note: Strophic song of praise.

concepts.label: Anthem
concepts.note: Solemn, collective piece; by extension, a mass sing-along song.

concepts.label: Lullaby
concepts.note: Soft song for sleep.

concepts.label: Lament
concepts.note: Piece of mourning or grievance.

concepts.label: Serenade
concepts.note: Amorous or light piece, originally performed at night.

concepts.label: Ballad
concepts.note: Song that tells a story; in pop, a slow song.

concepts.label: Power ballad
concepts.note: Ballad that builds to a finale with full-power guitars and drums.

concepts.label: Rhapsody
concepts.note: Free, episodic piece.

concepts.label: Fantasia
concepts.note: Free piece with an improvisatory character.

concepts.label: Cadenza
concepts.note: Free, virtuosic solo passage.

concepts.label: Overture
concepts.note: Introductory orchestral piece.

concepts.label: Suite
concepts.note: Series of linked pieces or dances.

concepts.label: Concerto
concepts.note: Work for soloist and orchestra.

concepts.label: Symphony
concepts.note: Orchestral work in several movements.

concepts.label: Cantata
concepts.note: Vocal work in several movements.

concepts.label: Oratorio
concepts.note: Dramatic choral-orchestral work without staging.

concepts.label: Opera
concepts.note: Staged drama sung throughout.

concepts.label: Jazz standard
concepts.note: Repertoire tune used for improvisation.

concepts.label: Texture
concepts.note: How simultaneous lines combine.

concepts.label: Monophony
concepts.note: A single unaccompanied melodic line.

concepts.label: Homophony
concepts.note: Main melody with chordal accompaniment.

concepts.label: Polyphony
concepts.note: Several independent simultaneous lines.

concepts.label: Heterophony
concepts.note: Simultaneous variants of the same melody.

concepts.label: Unison
concepts.note: Several voices or instruments on the same pitch.

concepts.label: Sparse texture
concepts.note: Few elements at a time, lots of space.

concepts.label: Dense texture
concepts.note: Many simultaneous layers.

concepts.label: Counterpoint
concepts.note: Combining independent lines under voice-leading rules.

concepts.label: Imitation
concepts.note: One voice repeats another's material.

concepts.label: Voice leading
concepts.note: How each voice moves between chords.

concepts.label: Hocket
concepts.note: A melody split note by note between voices.

concepts.label: Accompaniment textures
concepts.note: Typical accompaniment patterns.

concepts.label: Comping
concepts.note: Rhythmic, irregular chords under a soloist.

concepts.label: Alberti bass
concepts.note: Broken chord in low-high-middle-high order.

concepts.label: Harmonized lines
concepts.note: Two instruments play the same line a third or sixth apart.

concepts.label: Drone
concepts.note: Note or chord sustained throughout the piece.

concepts.label: Call and response
concepts.note: Alternation between a solo phrase and a reply.

concepts.label: Antiphony
concepts.note: Alternation between two choirs or groups.

concepts.label: Layering
concepts.note: Elements entering progressively and stacking up.

concepts.label: Voice types
concepts.note: Voice classification by range and ensemble.

concepts.label: Duet
concepts.note: Two singers alternating or singing together.

concepts.label: Soprano
concepts.note: Highest female voice.

concepts.label: Contralto
concepts.note: Lowest female voice.

concepts.label: Countertenor
concepts.note: Male voice in the alto range.

concepts.label: Tenor
concepts.note: High male voice.

concepts.label: Baritone
concepts.note: Middle male voice.

concepts.label: Bass voice
concepts.note: Lowest male voice.

concepts.label: Choir
concepts.note: Large vocal ensemble.

concepts.label: Gospel choir
concepts.note: Gospel-style choir with handclaps and call and response.

concepts.label: Gang vocals
concepts.note: Several voices shouting in unison; punk and hardcore.

concepts.label: Chant
concepts.note: Collective singing recited on few notes.

concepts.label: Singing techniques
concepts.note: Techniques of sung vocal production.

concepts.label: Chest voice
concepts.note: Low, resonant register.

concepts.label: Head voice
concepts.note: High, light register.

concepts.label: Falsetto
concepts.note: High, airy register above the natural voice.

concepts.label: Belting
concepts.note: Chest register pushed high with great power.

concepts.label: Mixed voice
concepts.note: Blend of chest and head.

concepts.label: Vocal vibrato
concepts.note: Periodic pitch oscillation.

concepts.label: Breathy vocals
concepts.note: Delivery with lots of air.

concepts.label: Whisper
concepts.note: Voice without vocal-fold vibration.

concepts.label: Vocal fry
concepts.note: Crackly delivery in the lowest register.

concepts.label: Raspy vocals
concepts.note: Light, rough distortion; rock and soul.

concepts.label: Twang
concepts.note: Bright, nasal timbre; country.

concepts.label: Yodel
concepts.note: Rapid jumps between chest voice and falsetto.

concepts.label: Vocal hiccup
concepts.note: Clipped breaks in the voice; rockabilly.

concepts.label: Crooning
concepts.note: Soft singing close to the microphone.

concepts.label: Operatic singing
concepts.note: Classical technique projecting without a microphone.

concepts.label: Melismatic singing
concepts.note: Style rich in melismas.

concepts.label: Vocal runs
concepts.note: Fast passages of notes on one syllable; R&B and gospel.

concepts.label: Cante jondo
concepts.note: Melismatic, raw flamenco singing.

concepts.label: Overtone singing
concepts.note: One voice producing a note and its overtones at once.

concepts.label: Humming
concepts.note: Singing with the mouth closed.

concepts.label: Whistling
concepts.note: Whistled melody.

concepts.label: Vocalise
concepts.note: Singing on vowels without text.

concepts.label: Scat singing
concepts.note: Vocal improvisation with nonsense syllables; jazz.

concepts.label: Ululation
concepts.note: High tongue trill, typical of North Africa and the Middle East.

concepts.label: Harsh vocals
concepts.note: Distorted vocal techniques of metal and hardcore.

concepts.label: Growl
concepts.note: Low guttural voice of death metal.

concepts.label: Scream
concepts.note: Mid-to-high distorted scream.

concepts.label: Fry scream
concepts.note: High scream based on vocal fry.

concepts.label: False chord scream
concepts.note: Scream using the false vocal folds.

concepts.label: Shriek
concepts.note: High shriek of black metal.

concepts.label: Pig squeal
concepts.note: High, pig-like guttural of deathcore and slam.

concepts.label: Clean vocals
concepts.note: Undistorted singing, in contrast to harsh vocals.

concepts.label: Shouted vocals
concepts.note: Shouted, non-guttural voice; punk and hardcore.

concepts.label: Spoken and rapped vocals
concepts.note: Non-sung vocal delivery.

concepts.label: Spoken word
concepts.note: Spoken text over music.

concepts.label: Sprechgesang
concepts.note: Technique halfway between speech and song.

concepts.label: Rap
concepts.note: Rhythmic, rhymed delivery.

concepts.label: Flow
concepts.note: Rhythmic pattern of a rap delivery.

concepts.label: Double-time rap
concepts.note: Rap at double the apparent speed.

concepts.label: Triplet flow
concepts.note: Rap in eighth-note triplets.

concepts.label: Melodic rap
concepts.note: Rap with a melodic contour, often with autotune.

concepts.label: Mumble delivery
concepts.note: Relaxed, loosely articulated diction.

concepts.label: Toasting
concepts.note: Jamaican rhythmic chanting over riddims.

concepts.label: Beatboxing
concepts.note: Percussion imitated with the mouth.

concepts.label: Vocal arrangement
concepts.note: Arrangement of voices on the recording.

concepts.label: Vocal harmonies
concepts.note: Several voices at different pitches.

concepts.label: Close harmony
concepts.note: Tightly voiced parts; doo-wop, barbershop.

concepts.label: Double-tracked vocals
concepts.note: The same vocal take recorded twice.

concepts.label: Ad-libs
concepts.note: Spontaneous vocal interjections.

concepts.label: A cappella
concepts.note: Voices without instrumental accompaniment.

concepts.label: Vocal call and response
concepts.note: Soloist and choir alternating.

concepts.label: Clean electric guitar
concepts.note: Undistorted sound.

concepts.label: Extended-range guitar
concepts.note: Guitars with added low strings; modern metal.

concepts.label: Cavaquinho
concepts.note: Small four-string guitar of samba and choro.

concepts.label: Kora
concepts.note: 21-string harp-lute of the Mandinka griots.

concepts.label: Saz
concepts.note: Long-necked lute of Turkey and Anatolia.

concepts.label: Fiddle
concepts.note: Violin in folk, country and Celtic styles.

concepts.label: Didgeridoo
concepts.note: Australian Aboriginal drone aerophone.

concepts.label: Combo organ
concepts.note: Transistor organ of the 1960s.

concepts.label: Supersaw
concepts.note: Stacked detuned saw waves; trance and EDM.

concepts.label: Acid bass
concepts.note: TB-303 line with resonance and glides.

concepts.label: Reese bass
concepts.note: Detuned saw bass; drum and bass.

concepts.label: Reverse bass
concepts.note: Bass with a reversed envelope between kicks; hardstyle.

concepts.label: Wobble bass
concepts.note: LFO-modulated bass; dubstep.

concepts.label: Hoover sound
concepts.note: 90s rave synth sound.

concepts.label: Rave stab
concepts.note: Short, aggressive synth chord.

concepts.label: Step sequencer
concepts.note: Grid-programmed patterns that loop.

concepts.label: Roland TR-808
concepts.note: Drum machine whose long kick doubles as bass.

concepts.label: Roland TR-909
concepts.note: Drum machine of house and techno.

concepts.label: LinnDrum
concepts.note: Drum machine of 80s pop.

concepts.label: Sound chip
concepts.note: Sounds of vintage consoles and home computers.

concepts.label: Log drum
concepts.note: Percussive bass sound of amapiano.

concepts.label: Mridangam
concepts.note: Double-headed drum of Carnatic music.

concepts.label: Dhol
concepts.note: Double-headed drum from Punjab.

concepts.label: Gamelan
concepts.note: Ensemble of metallophones and gongs from Java and Bali.

concepts.label: Balafon
concepts.note: African xylophone with gourd resonators.

concepts.label: Power trio
concepts.note: Guitar, bass and drums.

concepts.label: Mariachi ensemble
concepts.note: Trumpets, violins, guitarrón and vihuela.

concepts.label: Palm muting
concepts.note: Strings damped with the palm for a dry, percussive sound.

concepts.label: Chugging
concepts.note: Repeated low muted power chords.

concepts.label: Djent riffing
concepts.note: Syncopated muted riffs on very low strings with a metallic attack.

concepts.label: Tremolo picking
concepts.note: Very fast alternate picking on one note; black metal, surf.

concepts.label: Sweep picking
concepts.note: Fast arpeggios with a sweeping pick stroke.

concepts.label: Tapping
concepts.note: Notes sounded by the picking hand on the fretboard.

concepts.label: Legato (guitar)
concepts.note: Slurred notes without picking.

concepts.label: String bending
concepts.note: Stretching the string to raise the pitch.

concepts.label: Pinch harmonics
concepts.note: High harmonics produced with the pick; metal.

concepts.label: Slide guitar
concepts.note: Notes slid with a tube along the strings.

concepts.label: Fingerpicking
concepts.note: Playing with the fingers.

concepts.label: Travis picking
concepts.note: Alternating thumb bass with finger-played melody.

concepts.label: Rasgueado
concepts.note: Fan-like strums of flamenco guitar.

concepts.label: Picado
concepts.note: Fast scales plucked with alternating fingers.

concepts.label: Chicken picking
concepts.note: Clucky, staccato country picking.

concepts.label: Funk guitar scratching
concepts.note: Percussive strumming on muted strings.

concepts.label: Skank guitar
concepts.note: Short offbeat chord; reggae and ska.

concepts.label: Jangle guitar
concepts.note: Bright arpeggios of open chords; jangle pop.

concepts.label: Shred guitar
concepts.note: Virtuosic high-speed solos.

concepts.label: Neoclassical shred
concepts.note: Shred based on Baroque scales and arpeggios.

concepts.label: Guitar feedback
concepts.note: Controlled amplifier feedback.

concepts.label: Drop tuning
concepts.note: Tuning with the lowest string lowered.

concepts.label: Open tuning
concepts.note: Tuning that forms a chord on open strings.

concepts.label: Chord melody
concepts.note: Harmonized melody on a single guitar.

concepts.label: Slap bass
concepts.note: Thumb slap and string pop.

concepts.label: Walking bass
concepts.note: Quarter-note bass outlining the chords; jazz.

concepts.label: Octave bass
concepts.note: Bass alternating octaves; disco.

concepts.label: Sub-bass
concepts.note: Low frequencies below ~60 Hz.

concepts.label: Bass glides
concepts.note: Pitch glides in the bass.

concepts.label: Stride piano
concepts.note: Left hand alternating bass and chord; early jazz.

concepts.label: Boogie-woogie bass
concepts.note: Left-hand blues figures in ostinato.

concepts.label: Montuno
concepts.note: Syncopated, repeated piano figure in salsa.

concepts.label: Leslie speaker
concepts.note: Rotating effect of the Hammond organ.

concepts.label: Pizzicato
concepts.note: Strings plucked with the fingers.

concepts.label: String tremolo
concepts.note: Very fast bowed repetition.

concepts.label: Col legno
concepts.note: Striking with the wood of the bow.

concepts.label: Saxophone growl
concepts.note: Saxophone with voice added; rough sound.

concepts.label: Brass stabs
concepts.note: Short hits from the horn section.

concepts.label: Falls and doits
concepts.note: Brass glissandos at the end of a note.

concepts.label: Scratching
concepts.note: Moving the vinyl to create rhythms.

concepts.label: Recording aesthetic
concepts.note: Overall character of the recorded sound.

concepts.label: Lo-fi
concepts.note: Deliberately imperfect, saturated or muffled sound.

concepts.label: Polished production
concepts.note: Clean, compressed, competitive sound.

concepts.label: Raw production
concepts.note: Direct sound with little editing.

concepts.label: Live recording
concepts.note: Concert or live-in-studio take.

concepts.label: Wall of sound
concepts.note: Dense layers with heavy reverb; Phil Spector, shoegaze.

concepts.label: Bass-heavy mix
concepts.note: Bass dominates the mix.

concepts.label: Dry mix
concepts.note: Little reverb, close sound.

concepts.label: Field recording
concepts.note: Environmental sounds recorded outside the studio.

concepts.label: Compression
concepts.note: Reducing dynamic range.

concepts.label: Sidechain compression
concepts.note: The signal ducks with each kick.

concepts.label: Spring reverb
concepts.note: Metallic amplifier reverb; surf.

concepts.label: Gated reverb
concepts.note: Abruptly cut-off reverb; 80s drums.

concepts.label: Shimmer reverb
concepts.note: Reverb with an added upper octave.

concepts.label: Delay
concepts.note: Repetitions of the signal.

concepts.label: Slapback echo
concepts.note: Single short echo; rockabilly.

concepts.label: Dub echo
concepts.note: Feedback delays manipulated live.

concepts.label: Chorus effect
concepts.note: Slightly detuned doubling.

concepts.label: Tremolo effect
concepts.note: Periodic volume variation.

concepts.label: Distortion
concepts.note: Clipping that adds harmonics.

concepts.label: Overdrive
concepts.note: Mild tube saturation.

concepts.label: Fuzz
concepts.note: Harsh, square-wave distortion.

concepts.label: Bitcrusher
concepts.note: Digital resolution reduction.

concepts.label: Filter sweep
concepts.note: Gradual opening or closing of a filter.

concepts.label: Resonant filter
concepts.note: Filter with pronounced resonance; acid.

concepts.label: Wah-wah
concepts.note: Foot-swept filter pedal.

concepts.label: Auto-Tune
concepts.note: Audible pitch correction used as an effect.

concepts.label: Slowed and reverb
concepts.note: Slowed-down version with reverb; or the chopped and screwed technique.

concepts.label: Reverse
concepts.note: Recording played backwards.

concepts.label: Stutter edit
concepts.note: Choppy repetitions of a fragment.

concepts.label: Tape stop
concepts.note: Simulated tape slowdown to a halt.

concepts.label: Sampling
concepts.note: Reusing recorded fragments.

concepts.label: Loop
concepts.note: Fragment repeated cyclically.

concepts.label: Vocal chops
concepts.note: Chopped vocal fragments used as an instrument.

concepts.label: Sample flip
concepts.note: Creative transformation of a recognizable sample.

concepts.label: Sound design
concepts.note: Non-musical sound elements with a structural role.

concepts.label: Riser
concepts.note: Rising sound that builds tension.

concepts.label: Downlifter
concepts.note: Falling sound after a climax.

concepts.label: Impact
concepts.note: Low hit at the start of a section.

concepts.label: Braam
concepts.note: Distorted low brass from trailers.

concepts.label: Sub drop
concepts.note: Pitch drop in the sub-bass.

concepts.label: Era aesthetic
concepts.note: Production traits associated with a decade.

concepts.label: Dynamics
concepts.note: Management of volume and intensity.

concepts.label: Crescendo
concepts.note: Gradual increase in intensity.

concepts.label: Sforzando
concepts.note: Sudden, strong accent.

concepts.label: Dynamic contrast
concepts.note: Alternating soft and explosive sections.

concepts.label: Slow build
concepts.note: Intensity that grows throughout the piece.

concepts.label: Articulation
concepts.note: How notes are attacked and connected.

concepts.label: Staccato
concepts.note: Short, separated notes.

concepts.label: Legato
concepts.note: Notes connected without a break.

concepts.label: Lyrical devices
concepts.note: Lyric-writing devices.

concepts.label: Rhyme scheme
concepts.note: Distribution of rhymes (AABB, ABAB…).

concepts.label: Internal rhyme
concepts.note: Rhymes within the same line.

concepts.label: Multisyllabic rhyme
concepts.note: Chained multi-syllable rhymes; rap.

concepts.label: Storytelling
concepts.note: The lyrics tell a story with characters.

concepts.label: Punchline
concepts.note: Witty closing line; rap.

concepts.label: Title drop
concepts.note: The title appears in the hook.

concepts.label: Vocables
concepts.note: Meaningless sung syllables.

concepts.label: Code-switching
concepts.note: Switching languages within the lyrics.

concepts.label: Protest lyrics
concepts.note: Social or political lyrics.

concepts.label: Confessional lyrics
concepts.note: Intimate first-person lyrics.

concepts.label: Instrumental
concepts.note: Piece without vocals.

concepts.label: Mood
concepts.note: Affective descriptors. Not technical devices, but music-generation prompts rely on them heavily.

concepts.label: Anthemic
concepts.note: Made to be sung by a crowd.
